status: Source inspected; runtime floor/ceiling death and debris review pending
facing: left; mirror around runtime anchor for right
scale_rule: Base logical source scale. Apply same existing actor visual multiplier to every phase; do not normalize each pose to same height.
alpha_preparation: Derived runtime texture alpha cutoff240 removes generated background haze; retain raw RGBA source.

floor.support: Keep base supported during first3 frames; clip below actual support plane for tiny falling fragments so none embed underground.
floor.motion: One-way crack, separation, collapse, bounce, settle; no looping, sad-pose hold or whole-enemy fade.
floor.remains: Frame5 stays fully visible at support after0.54s. Persist with same world/remains lifecycle as toilets. Noncolliding and harmless; do not disappear with actor removal.

ceiling.initial: Do not flip floor base into hanging debris. Use existing ceiling body/barrel as detached components at actual death transforms.
ceiling.fall: Detach body and barrel from mount, disable attacks immediately; gravity/rotation toward real supporting surface below. Retain fixed mount plate if physically attached. No hanging floor wreck.
ceiling.landing: At actual support contact play frames3,4,5 upright, matched gauge size; permanent pile on that floor/platform. If over pit, fall visibly into pit, do not invent floating debris.
ceiling.ownership: Engineering owns support queries and trajectory; source provides landing collapse/remains.

debris_identity: Shattered pressure gauge with dark eyes
audio_note: Markers are visual suggestions; reuse suitable existing metal break/settle cues or consult Audio. Ceiling impact marker follows actual landing.
scope: Sputtervalve floor/ceiling only; broader regular-monster death-sign policy belongs to Engineering, possible scrolling2.1 exception not resolved here.
preserve: Original shooter atlases and manifests retained
